title: Glowing Trim Totem
description:
glowing trim totem just rename the totem , 16 colors with 18 trims, trims on totem
version from 1.16 to latest
body:
✨ Glowing Trim Totem Pack ✨

🔥 Transform your Totem of Undying into a glowing, customizable artifact that stands out in every moment.

💡 16 Colors × 18 Designs = 288 Unique Combinations

Customize your Totem of Undying with 16 colors and 18 unique glowing trim designs — all with smooth glowing effects that work even without shaders.

Stand out. Feel different.

────────────────────────
⚡ Features

• 🌈 16 Color Variants
• 🛡️ 18 Trim Designs
• ✨ Glowing (Emissive) Effects
• 🎮 Works with & without shaders
• 🔥 Lightweight & multiplayer-friendly
• ⚡ Mix & match colors and trims to create your own unique style

────────────────────────

🎯 Why Use This Pack?

• Instantly recognize your Totem in intense situations
• Adds a premium, high-quality visual upgrade
• Perfect for PvP, Survival, and Multiplayer flex
• Makes every revival moment feel powerful

────────────────────────

📌 How It Works

Rename your Totem using:
[Color Code] + [Design Code]

Examples:
r14, a10, l6, g7, c4, d16, n9, q12, ch18

✨ Instantly updates your Totem in-game — no commands, no hassle.

• Updated inventory & hotbar Totem visuals

────────────────────────

⚙️ Requirements

• OptiFine (Required for full functionality)
• Enable:

  • Custom Items

────────────────────────

• EMF (Entity Model Features)
• ETF (Entity Texture Features)
• Continuity
• CIT Resewn
• Indium

Forge Mods:
• EMF (Entity Model Features)
• ETF (Entity Texture Features)
• Connectedness
• Fusion (Connected Textures)

────────────────────────

❗ Troubleshooting

• Reload resource packs if it stops working
• Check OptiFine version
• Make sure OptiFine is installed correctly

────────────────────────

🌍 Compatibility

• ✔ Singleplayer & Multiplayer
• ✔ Minecraft 1.16 → Latest
• ✔ Separate files for each version

────────────────────────

🎉 Final Note

Upgrade your Totem.  
Glow brighter. Survive in style.

Because in the moment that matters most—
your Totem should stand out.

❤️ Thanks for downloading!
